description: RAG chunk-converter currently emits file-level chunks with dependencyCount=0/dependentCount=0 even though .coderef/index.json carries usedBy[] for 1486 elements (post-merge fe6bdc9). Either (a) extend chunk-converter to include element-level chunks with relationship metadata so semantic queries can leverage usedBy/imports/exports, or (b) formally ratify file-level chunking as by-design and document the rationale (semantic relationship search → query index.json directly, not RAG). Surfaced by WO-CODEREF-CORE-POST-MERGE-SCANNER-VALIDATION-001 Phase 3.
